# Recent Developments (L12M)

**Scope note:** Acme Advisory is a one-person practice run by Sam Rivera. The public record is thin. Everything below comes from Acme Advisory's own site, its Substack and LinkedIn. No press coverage, funding records or award listings were found. Several unrelated companies are also called "Parallel", such as Parallel Web Systems, Parallel Systems and a Paris hospital AI startup. Their news is excluded.

## Launches

- **Positioning pivot on the website (undated, inferred).** Two versions of acme-advisory.example were found.
  - The older version, seen in a search snippet, described Acme Advisory as an AI consulting practice helping executives lead AI transformation. It listed three areas: AI strategy and change leadership, AI sales enablement and automation, and AI governance and ISO 42001 compliance. The headline was "Define Your North."
  - The current version is titled "Human Intelligence for AI-Enabled Product & Revenue Leaders". It offers advisory, products and workshops for product, growth and AI.
  - I assume the current version is newer, because it carries a 2026 copyright line. Neither version is dated, so the timing is an assumption.
- **Advisory in three tracks (current site):**
  - Product management discipline for SaaS startup founders.
  - Product-led growth and GTM strategy for revenue leaders.
  - AI transformation for small and medium businesses.
- **Productized tools (current site):**
  - 10x Employee, an AI operating system that amplifies every employee.
  - Private AI, which runs inside the client's office so client data stays there.
  - AI Chief of Staff, listed as free.
  - AI Use Policy Generator, listed as free. It produces a one-page AI use policy, approved tools list, vendor checklist and team rollout.
  - Sales Enablement Automation, which turns positioning into a playbook, battlecards and call plans. This links to a "positioninghq" page.
  - The site does not show launch dates for any of these.
- **Workshops (current site):**
  - AI Accelerator, two days for CEOs and founders. It is by application, with dates to be announced.
  - Executive AI Fluency, three hands-on sessions where each leader builds an AI chief of staff.
- **Newsletter: Inhouse.Build (Substack).** It covers companies building solutions in-house now that AI has cut the cost of building. The page said it launched "a month ago" when it was cached. The exact launch date is not available.
- **Thought leadership signals (LinkedIn):**
  - A post dated 2026-04-30 argued that AI use is slowing procurement and that a SOC 2 report does not address AI.
  - Another post said Sam is researching mid-market executives who cancel SaaS subscriptions and build AI capabilities in-house. This matches the newsletter theme.

## Financials

- No funding rounds, acquisitions, partnerships or revenue figures for Acme Advisory were found. This is Not available, not a confirmed absence.
- The company profile says the company size is "Just me". This fits a self-funded solo practice, but I could not confirm how it is funded.
- Do not cite the $100M and $230M rounds you may see under "Parallel". They belong to Parallel Web Systems and Parallel Systems.

## Leadership

- Sam Rivera is the sole named leader. He has spent 25 years building business software companies and was VP of Product at Galvanize as it scaled to a $1B exit. He was also Chief Product & Technology Officer at Boast AI.
- Experience claims differ across site versions. The older version says 20 years and the current one says 25 years. Fix this on the site.
- No leadership changes were found.
- **Strategic pivot (inferred):** the practice moved from an executive-level AI strategy, governance and ISO 42001 offer to a broader offer. It now covers product and growth advisory for SaaS founders and revenue leaders, productized AI tools, workshops and a newsletter. The old ISO 42001 and governance framing no longer appears in the current navigation. A policy generator remains.

## Awards

- No awards, analyst mentions or industry recognition were found. This is Not available.
